description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component used for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface, formats log data, and displays it in the UI, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages, handles thread safety for UI updates, and chains to next log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then displays it in the LogView, converting priority to readable text and handling UI threading.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string with a delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
